hints: Sort the edges by weight, then walk them in order taking any edge whose endpoints are in different sets.
unite() already returns whether the edge was safe to take - 1 means it joined two different components, 0 means it would have closed a cycle.
Count the edges you take. A connected graph on n vertices needs exactly n-1; anything less means the graph was disconnected, so return -1.
title: Kruskal: total MST cost
